about: Effects for stat text the parser cannot model (R6), keyed by uniqueName. `effects` (domain Effect fields) replace the parsed ones and set support to full unless `support` is given; `support` + `note` alone only adjust the status. Values come from the entry's own DE text or a saved wiki page named in `note`; never guessed. Refresh fails on an entry that matches nothing.

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Zariman/Pistols/Hea.note: Laetum page, EVO5: '50% chance to deal +2000% damage on non-critical hits'; notes: multiplicative to base damage bonuses
